itemList.description: Wall painting with acrylicemulsion paint, having VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) content less than 50 g/L, of approved brand andmanufacture, including applying additional coats wherever required, to achieve even shade and colour. Two coats as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 8.53.2, pg-50.( upto height of two floors i.e., 6.5mtr.)

Distempering with 1st quality acrylic distemper (ready made) having VOC content less than 50 g/l of approved manufacturer and of required shade and colour complete. as per manufacturer's specification.One coats on old work including preparing the surface after thoroughly cleaning the surface to remove all dirt, dust and foreign matter, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge. KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 8.71, pg-52

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand andmanufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work afterthoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar dropsand foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand papersmooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as perdirections of Engineer-in-charge.  KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 8.40, pg-48 ( upto height of two floors i.e., 6.5mtr.)

Providing and applying white cement based putty of average thickness 1 mm, of approved brand and manufacturer, over the plastered wall surface to prepare the surface even and smooth complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 8.51, pg-50

Applying priming coats with primer of approved brand andmanufacture, having low VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) content.With water thinnable cement primer on wall surface having VOC contentless than 50 g/L as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer in charge. KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 8.55.2, pg-51

Repairs to plaster in patches of 2.5 m2 and less in walls, ceilings 10 to20mm thick in cement mortar 1:4 including cutting the patches in propershape and replastering the surface of the wall including disposal of rubbishwith a lead of 50m including curing cost of materials, labour, completeas per specification. KPWD SR 2023-24, V-2 sl no. 20.89, pg-206

Providing and applying painting in two  coats  with weatherproof  emulsion paint  (Apex  - Asian  Make  or  equivalent  )  over  a  coat  of  primer  of  approved  brand  and  manufacture  on External    wall surface to give an even approved shade after thoroughly brushing the surface, free from mortar drops and other foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper  smooth,  filling  of  minor  cracks  with  approved  crack  seal  filling  materials  ,cost  of materials,  labour,   complete  all  as  per  spfd  in  KBS  specification  2008.(Lift  and   Scaffolding charges inclusive for all heights).
